answer.line: Every weight equals the mean, so every distance from the mean is 0. No spread, no variance.

steps: Name what variance measures: how far the values spread out from their mean.
Find the mean. Four weights of 3 grams average to 3 grams.
Measure each distance: 3 - 3 = 0 for every sample. Squared, still 0. The average of zeros is 0.

choices.note: Four identical values: no spread at all.
No rule lands on 1. Identical values sit no distance from the mean, so the variance is 0.
3 grams is the mean, where every dot sits. Variance asks how far the dots sit from it.
9 is 3 squared, the average of the squared weights. Variance subtracts the squared mean too: 9 - 9 = 0.
12 grams is the total weight, 4 x 3. Spread has nothing to do with the total.

lockIt: Variance measures spread from the mean. Identical values sit 0 away, so their variance is 0.
